title: Rheome: a MATLAB toolbox for the multiscale geometry of human cortical dynamics
description: Rheome is a MATLAB toolbox for the multiscale geometry of human cortical dynamics: spatiotemporal dynamics on graphs -- cortical meshes, connectomes and sensor arrays. Graph wavelet frames (rheome.graphfilterbank, rheome.jointfilterbank, rheome.timefilterbank) modelled on MATLAB's cwtfilterbank, the joint (lambda, omega) plane, phase geometry, and cortical flow (divergence, rotation, Helmholtz-Hodge, surface optical flow) from MEG source estimates. Installable as rheome-1.0.1.mltbx (MATLAB R2023b or later).
